name: codex-jetbrains-native-diff
description: Review Codex patches and attach IntelliJ editor context to the next prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Native patch review and editor context for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a manual review flow for Codex CLI and a configurable IntelliJ shortcut that attaches the active file or selected lines to the next prompt.
defaultPrompt: Make this change and let me review the native IntelliJ diff.
